newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PEACOCK LEAVES CHELSEA FOR QPR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEACOCK LEAVES CHELSEA FOR QPR.

text.p: Midfielder Gavin Peacock has joined first division Queen's Park Rangers from premier league Chelsea in a move worth around one million pounds ($1.65 million).
Peacock, on loan to QPR for the past month, has signed a 3-1/2-deal for an initial fee of 800,000 pounds ($1.32 million) which will rise to one million pounds after a certain number of appearances.
Peacock, 29, started his career at Rangers before leaving for Gillingham nine years ago. He was also linked with clubs in France and Spain.
"I had options to move abroad on a free transfer at the end of the season but I'm glad that it has been finally sorted out with QPR," he said.
"This is where I started and learned my trade."
Peacock was Chelsea captain and played in the 1994 FA Cup final, but had not played under new player-manager Ruud Gullit.
